sources.title: The Uttarakhand Tenancy Act, 2021
sources.publisher: Uttarakhand Urban Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.version: Act No. 02 of 2022; official Uttarakhand UDD copy listed 2025-12-29; commencement notification under section 1(3) not verified
sources.verificationNote: Matched Act No. 02 of 2022 and the Act title against the official Uttarakhand Urban Development Department listing and linked PDF on 2026-11-04. Section 1(3) commencement notification remains unverified; this does not establish current operation.

sources.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
sources.version: Act No. 35 of 2019; India Code record 123456789/16103
sources.verificationNote: Act ID 201935, Act No. 35, enactment date 2019-08-09 and title matched against the official India Code record. The Department of Consumer Affairs page lists the Act and separate commencement notifications. This verifies source identity only; amendments, provision-level commencement and currentness require separate review.

sources.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
sources.version: India Code consolidated text as on 2025-11-21; Act No. 29 of 2019; India Code Act ID 201929; staged commencement includes S.O. 5322(E) for specified provisions
sources.verificationNote: Act ID 201929, Act No. 29, enactment date 2019-08-08 and title matched against the official India Code record. Gazette S.O. 5322(E) dated 2025-11-21 commences only its listed provisions; no blanket commencement date is inferred.
sources.freshnessEvidence: Compared the India Code consolidated Code on Wages PDF labelled as on 21 November 2025 with Gazette S.O. 454(E), dated 30 January 2026. The later notification sets the supervisory-worker wage ceiling at ₹18,000 per month under section 2(z)(d), which is absent from the stored 2025 consolidated snapshot. Marked stale pending a refreshed snapshot and review of affected provisions.

sources.title: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
sources.version: Act No. 14 of 2013; India Code text last updated 2021-08-31
sources.verificationNote: Act No. 14 of 2013, title and PDF last-updated date matched against the official India Code PDF. The Ministry of Women and Child Development lists the Act. This does not establish that the PDF includes all later amendments.

sources.title: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
sources.version: Act No. 43 of 2005; official India Code text
sources.verificationNote: Act No. 43 of 2005 and title matched against the official India Code PDF. The Ministry of Women and Child Development lists the Act. This verifies source identity only; currentness and amendments are not assessed.

sources.title: Cabinet approves Model Tenancy Act for circulation to States/UTs for adoption
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
sources.verificationNote: Matched PIB release ID 1723636, its 2021-06-02 publication date, and its statement that the Model Tenancy Act was circulated to States/UTs for adoption against the official PIB release on 2026-11-04. This is an institutional announcement, not enacted State tenancy law.

sources.title: Union Government's Four Labour Codes Simplify and Streamline Labour Laws
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
sources.verificationNote: Release ID, Ministry, publication date and its announcement about the four Labour Codes matched against the official PIB release. The release is institutional context, not a substitute for the individual commencement notifications.

sources.title: Gazette of India notification bringing the Code on Wages, 2019 into force
sources.publisher: Gazette of India, Government of India
sources.verificationNote: Primary Gazette PDF matched identifier CG-DL-E-21112025-267885 and notification S.O. 5322(E), dated 2025-11-21. The notification specifies which Code on Wages provisions commence; it does not make every provision effective.
